integration_method: After full validation and fresh remote comparison, atomic normal no-force fast-forward push of task HEAD to main, chatgpt/planning-snapshot and exact task branch; advance unchecked-out local main/planning refs by compare-and-swap after ancestry verification. Preserve prior recovery branch and all checkpoint commits.
permitted_content: Only prior and current completed background source evidence, task governance, one inventory approval, deterministic accounting and resume pointer. No visitor-visible/R2 mutations.
separate_evidence_transport: A subsequent background evidence commit records the verified integrated snapshot; its transport does not rewrite the snapshot commit identity.
